title: Quality Over Quantity In Training
definition: The principle that emphasizes the importance of quality and precision over volume in training AI models.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Instead of using lots of data, it's better to use high-quality, well-crafted data to train AI models because it leads to better results.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The practice of prioritizing smaller, well-curated datasets over larger, less-refined datasets for achieving better AI model performance.
difficulty_levels.expert: A paradigm shift in AI training that emphasizes the use of high-quality, handcrafted datasets over large, machine-generated ones, leading to more stable, less prone-to-failure models.

extra_fields.insight: The discovery that quality outperforms quantity in AI training.
